metadata.title: fix(tests): auto-install pytest-playwright for test-mcp-rbac target
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- `make test-mcp-rbac` failed because `pytest-playwright` (optional `[playwright]` dependency group) was not installed in the venv
- The Makefile target now auto-detects missing `pytest-playwright` and installs `.[playwright]` + Chromium browser binaries before running tests

## Test plan
- [x] `make test-mcp-rbac` passes (40/40 tests) on a fresh venv with only `make install-dev`

commits.message:
fix(tests): auto-install pytest-playwright for test-mcp-rbac target

The RBAC e2e tests depend on pytest-playwright (which provides the
`playwright` fixture), but it lives in the optional [playwright]
dependency group. The Makefile target now checks for the package and
auto-installs it along with Chromium browser binaries before running.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
